'''Focusing Chambers''' were weapon components used on [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] such as the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G]]. They connected the weapon's [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]] to the laser [[Barrel/Legends|barrels]].<ref name="EGWT" />
